items.descriptionTR: Aid agencies are racing to support health workers in the Democratic Republic of Congo as an Ebola outbreak spreads in a remote mining town in the east. The virus has been confirmed in 380 cases, with at least 84 deaths reported, though the true toll may be higher. Reporting from the epicenter links the outbreak to gold mining, which has long been the lifeblood of the hill town and is now helping drive the spread of the virus. Health workers are treating the sick and burying the dead, but grief, mistrust and denial among some residents are complicating containment efforts. The outbreak comes as the world has improved vaccine development and coordination since 2014-2016, while China is seen as well positioned to help fill a gap left by U.S. retreat.
items.titleTR: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo linked to gold mining as aid agencies race to respond

slots.packetSpot: China is well positioned to help stop the deadly virus, and could move into a gap left by U.S. retreat. ⁂ Mining has been the lifeblood of this remote Congolese hill town for decades. Now, it is fueling the spread of a devastating virus. ⁂ Aid agencies are racing to help health workers in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The virus is known to have killed at least 84, but the true toll may be far higher. ⁂ The vaccine development process and coordination between health organizations have improved since a devastating 2014-2016 outbreak. ⁂ Our chief Africa correspondent, Declan Walsh, reports from the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak on how the gold mining industry and the outbreak are linked. ⁂ In a remote mining town at the center of the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak, grief and mistrust are complicating efforts to stop the virus. Health workers are trying to treat the ill and bury the dead, but some residents are still in denial that the disease is even real. ⁂ There are now 380 confirmed cases of Ebola in DR Congo, far lower than initial estimates of suspected cases, writes Fergus Walsh.
slots.packetTitle: As Ebola Spreads in East Africa, Will China Step Up? ⁂ The Gold Mines at the Heart of This Ebola Outbreak ⁂ What to Know About the Ebola Outbreak ⁂ The World Has Learned From the Last Ebola Outbreak, but Gaps Remain ⁂ How Ebola Spreads Through Gold Mining ⁂ Mistrust Spreads With the Ebola Virus in Congo ⁂ Fall in official Ebola numbers appears to be good news but it's not that simple
